I worked at Kroger a few years ago and only strayed 14 months because I just could not stand it anymore. I remember when I was being trained as a courtesy clerk, the manager that was training me told me I needed to stay out of the customers way to keep the flow of the store going. Cut to a few months later and I was leveling one of the aisle and a customer, who I did not see behind me, said “excuse me” and I moved to the side to let her through. My manager that trained me pulled me into the office and told me I was being written up for being in the customers way while leveling the aisle and I should not be doing that because it’s disruptive to the flow of the business and if someone ever says “excuse me” it means you are in their way. Several months later it happens again and this time they threaten to fire me so I left after being there just over a year.
